label: WORDS_RUMOUR_1_SAW
text: The scavenger never paid somebody back. I was standing right there.
speaker: Estella Gaines

label: WORDS_RUMOUR_2_HEARD
text: They say the scavenger never paid somebody back.
speaker: Estella Gaines

label: WORDS_RUMOUR_3_WHERE
text: The scavenger never paid somebody back, somewhere down that way.
speaker: Estella Gaines

label: WORDS_RUMOUR_4_WHEN
text: The scavenger never paid somebody back, some night this week.
speaker: Estella Gaines

label: WORDS_RUMOUR_5_FLAT
text: The scavenger squeezed somebody. Ask anybody on this street. Rent does that to people.
speaker: Estella Gaines

label: WORDS_RUMOUR_6_SURE
text: The scavenger squeezed somebody. I was there, or near enough. Rent does that to people.
speaker: Estella Gaines
